'''Nongta''' was a [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Merchant/Legends|Merchant]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on-board [[Vaiken Spacedock]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He offered a selection of companion customizations and various other items to any Imperial individual.
